Google Maps Enhances AI Features and Hindi Support in India

Google has expanded its Ask Maps AI feature in India, introducing support for the Hindi language. The update also includes live public transport updates and AI-powered personalization for users. These enhancements aim to provide more contextual recommendations and real-time travel information. The feature now offers six new capabilities for millions of users in India.
